text:
marta: quick thought - what if node sidecars emit implicit degrade signals (latency spike / KV miss surge) and can request an autofallback locally?
kevin: sidecar voting could be low-latency, but how do we keep auditability?
ryan: speed is good, but need a single source of truth. tie sidecar requests to a decision_id for replay.
jess: sidecar emits a compact envelope to the pipeline, e.g. {source:sidecar-az1, trigger:kv_miss, val:0.72, request:degrade} and we log it.
marta: UX: console should show compact cards with one-click expand into the 30s signal trace + decision trace. Not a firehose.
kevin: inbox card: time, service, trigger, confidence, expand -> signals + arbiter response.
ryan: tag requests as implicit vs explicit and show heuristic name.
jess: error triggers too - sidecars seeing downstream 5xxs could request degrade, but require threshold + cooldown.
marta: rollout policy toggle: "allow sidecar-implicit fallback" with threshold, cooldown, notify-level. Default off for SLA customers.
ops-bot: deploy-bot note: sidecar metrics are indexed under sidecar.* but no decision_id attached.
jess: add decision_id header to sidecar emits; include it when calling rollout API so logs/traces link.
kevin: audit UX: timeline view filterable by decision_id, operator, service, reason. Default shows escalations only.
marta: split-brain risk - two sidecars flip-flopping. Use hysteresis + central arbiter. Console shows "requested by X, applied by Y".
ryan: arbitration: sidecar -> decisions.request topic, arbiter -> decisions.response (accepted|rejected|deferred). Console shows who applied.
jess: operator override: sticky override with TTL and required short annotation. Retain audit events 90 days, exportable CSV/JSON.
sam: security: sidecars need mTLS + node signer tokens; audit should log cert thumbprint. Pilot behind feature flag; metrics-only mode first.
kevin: action items: 1) eng-runtime: add decision_id header + kafka topic (owner: jess, due EOW) 2) eng-platform: arbiter API + audit schema (owner: ryan, due next Wed) 3) ux: inbox card + timeline mock (owner: kevin, due next Tue) 4) security: cert thumbprint + perms (owner: sam).
marta: consensus to pilot in single infra pool with metrics-only mode first. I'll draft RFC and UX flows. Thanks all.
ops-bot: NOTE: ticket INFRA-1129 created for sidecar decision infra.
